# Feedback-Control Comparison Admission (Provisional)

## Scope and Authority

This chapter records the F01 (#11785) **admission contract**, not a qualified
matching calculation. `src/config/engine_model_inventory.json` is the package
authority; `src/engines/feedback_comparison.py` derives required model/variant/
drive rows from it. Every registered package remains in the program denominator.
Required capability, declared support, runtime availability, and scientific
qualification are separate fields. An unavailable engine stays required and
unqualified. The calculation registry remains blocked for release.

The common forward-dynamics form is

$$
M(q;\theta)\dot v + h(q,v;\theta)
= S(q)^T\tau + J_c(q)^T\lambda + f_{\mathrm{external}},
\qquad \dot q=N(q)v.
$$

Here $q$ may lie on a configuration manifold and need not have the dimension
of $v$. A muscle plant replaces direct generalized effort with an excitation
input $e(t)$, internal activation/tendon/fiber state $z$, and a state-dependent
mapping $\tau=\tau(q,v,z,e;\theta_m)$. Recorded torque cannot be substituted
for excitation, or vice versa, as the same native input. Units are SI for
effort and seconds for time; excitation is dimensionless. Force, contact,
instrumented grip, and EMG observations are distinct evidence sources.

## Replay and Comparison Preconditions

An independent replay uses one saved full initial physical state and a
time-only input player with no state feedback or resets. Its model, provider,
physical state schema, execution policy, actuator schema, contact and
integration identities, applied input, observation set, horizon, and channel
order and simulation-relative timebase are bound by SHA-256 evidence. Each
input-channel schema digest includes target, coordinate, unit, and force frame.
Direct torque/force/effort is held
exactly over each integration step; excitation interpolation is declared.
Holding a command does not imply that a state-dependent actuator delivers
constant force. A matching state trajectory from a
transcription is insufficient; the native plant must reproduce it when
integrated separately. The existing `same-input-bundle/v1` has Euclidean
`nq=nv` arrays and does not bind policy and applied-input hashes, so it cannot
qualify this contract. F01 does not alter that older schema.

Identity, transcription-native feasibility, within-engine independent input
reproduction, cross-engine same-input, observation accuracy, and bounded
biomechanical equivalence are separate admission levels. A transcription
receipt does not satisfy an independent replay or observation-score receipt.
Same-input
requires equal physical-model, physics, contact, integrator, actuator,
state-schema, policy, time-grid, input, observation, horizon, and channel identities.
Common rigid-body emulation, native own-contact, and externally forced runs
must keep different evidence-mode labels. The shared full-body OpenSim parity
path removes native ForceSet/ConstraintSet/ContactGeometrySet, and MyoSuite's
shared-body path uses the MuJoCo rigid-body core. Neither establishes native
muscle/contact parity. A restarted 50 ms L2 result cannot establish continuous
full-swing native-muscle replay. Native muscle claims additionally require
muscle-state, contact, and force evidence across an uninterrupted horizon.

The prospective baseline names are independent polynomial, computed torque,
MOSAIC with time-varying LQR, and selected OCP. They must share observation
identity, physical horizon, and compute budget before accuracy or speed can be
compared. No F01 test measures tracking error, pass rate, energy, GRF, grip
load, muscle physiology, or runtime. `tests/unit/engines/test_feedback_comparison.py`
checks admission failures; F09 and later native lanes own numerical receipts.

## Uncertainty and Release Boundary

The inventory declares a flexible-club requirement but currently records its
support as unknown. OpenSim's eight-muscle variant factory and MyoSuite's
upstream myo_sim anatomy are declared, not calibrated full-swing physiology.
Provider/model hashes identify code and files, not physical validity. Model
parameters, observation clocks, camera/marker registration, contact forces,
muscle redundancy, and EMG coverage remain unqualified until independent
measured evidence and native replay receipts establish a bounded scope.
